The '''Mayor's Office''' was a building located on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and served as the official office of the [[Mayor/Legends|mayor]] of [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the office was occupied by the mayor of Kor Vella [[Deel Draav]].<ref name="SWG:CCFTLM" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] agent working for [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Lon Cope]] visited the office to discuss with Deel Draav about an assassination attempt he was victim.<ref name="SWG:CCFTLM" /> After Mayor Draav was finally assassinated in a second attempt, the agent returned to the office and investigated the place. The spacer discovered a large sum of credits sent by the criminals of the [[Chirq Council]] in order to bribe the mayor. The CorSec thus understood that Deel Draav was assassinated because he refused the money.<ref name="SWG:CCFTUM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|CorSec Case Files: The Unlucky Mayor|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Mayor's Office appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CCFTLM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Mayor's Office was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
